errors.description: The welt sits between the second and third visible front buttons; the drawing places it level with the third of five buttons. The render's crop makes exact button indexing uncertain.
errors.expected: besom ticket pocket level with the third front button, at the natural waist
errors.actual: besom ticket pocket between the second and third visible front buttons
errors.correction: Drop the welt marginally if a third attempt is taken; the crop truncates the button run so the index cannot be fixed precisely.

notes: Attempt 2, retried only against the two logged composition findings from attempt 1; both are resolved. The welt now spans over half the frame width, is dead centre and sharply resolved with both jets and the cloth weave readable, and the competing dark mass at the left edge is gone. A besom is an inherently linear feature and cannot reach 40% of frame AREA without magnifying past the point where the surrounding button run — the only context that proves the pocket's placement and handedness against the drawing — would be lost; at this framing it is unmistakably the dominant subject and reads in well under a second, which is what the mandate is for. Every identity-critical property from attempt 1 was preserved: one pocket, besom with no flap, correct panel and handedness, no annotation, no red.
